sections.content: Historical reports often use «se» when the actor is not the focus.

items.spanish: Se aplicaron medidas de austeridad mientras se negociaban nuevos acuerdos financieros.
items.english: Austerity measures were applied while new financial agreements were negotiated.

items.spanish: Se redujo el gasto público porque se buscaba estabilizar las cuentas.
items.english: Public spending was reduced because the aim was to stabilise the accounts.

items.spanish: Se introdujeron recortes, aunque se intentó proteger algunos servicios básicos.
items.english: Cuts were introduced, although an attempt was made to protect some basic services.

items.spanish: Se necesitaba un ajuste porque el Estado tenía menos margen financiero.
items.english: An adjustment was needed because the state had less financial room.

sections.content: With passive «se», the verb agrees with the noun: «se *aplicaron* *medidas*».
